task: Dear ranger <Ranger>, our planet's government was invited to send a representative to take part in the Intergalactic combat robot battle tournament which will take place on the <ToPlanet> planet in the <ToStar> system. We would hate refusing this offer due to diplomatic reasons. But these competitions are very dangerous. The fact that the participants can get killed is an absolutely common thing there but we can't afford risking our people's lives. On the other hand, the victory in this tournament is rather honorific. This is why we need a hireling - a professional fighter. We will pay you an adequate amount, <Money> cr. The last day of the participants' registration is <Date>.
success:
Our congratulations! All the <FromPlanet>'s population kept their breath listening to the sportscasts from the tournament. Your victory aroused a record patriotic enthusiasm! It was our first victory in such a competition. They have already erected a full-length monument on one of the main capital squares to pay a tribute to you. We hope that popularisation of this sport will help us to bring along talented sportsmen of our own. However, I would recommend you to abridge your visit to our planet and leave immediately: if the fans find out that you are here, you will not be leaving for the next several next years. <clr>John "God" O' Damned<clrEnd> - a Gaalian
<clr>Zen Cha-Cha<clrEnd> - a Faeyan
<clr>Steel Silvester <clrEnd> - a Human

<clr>Battle rules.<clrEnd>

You have tree types of weapons.
<clr>Blaster<clrEnd> - the weakest weapon but its sighting system is perfect. It is impossible to escape it. <clr> A power shield <clrEnd> is used against it.
<clr>Rocket launcher<clrEnd> volleys 3 rockets per one shot. The rockets are uncontrollable but they can cause much damage if all of them go home. However, their navigator leaves much to be desired - the cases when all rockets go home are rare. Moreover, it's easy to escape them with the help of <clr>antirocket manoeuvre <clrEnd>.
<clr>Torpedo tube <clrEnd> shoots with homing torpedoes. A couple of direct hits of such torpedoes will cause death easily. Unfortunately, their homing system can be jammed by <clr>the noise generator <clrEnd>. However, even if it bursts not far from the enemy, it can cause some damage.

During each round the opponents attack each other once. Before the battle they ballot for the attack turn and choose the attacking weapon (the blaster, the torpedo tube, or the rocket launcher) and the defending weapon (the power shield, the noise generator, or the antirocket manoeuvre). Naturally, none of the opponents know what weapon their enemies have chosen.

They fight until one of the combat robots is destroyed.

A robot can carry <clr>10 ammunition sets <clrEnd>. 2 blaster charges, 2 rocket sets and 2 torpedoes make a standard set provided from the beginning. 4 remaining sets are added on the participant's discretion.

He almost destroyed my robot with just two hits and smashed it with torpedo fragments. I didn't have time to do anything... I'm sure he bribed all the referees. Such blasters should be forbidden! Some crappy Gaalian...beat me, the Galaxy champion... with a crappy blaster... - the Galaxy champion among Maloqs became maudlin-drunk and the rest of his speech was completely thick.

You could tap nothing else out of him, so you went to your room and had a good night's rest. You went to the armoury first thing in the morning.
loc.99.2:
- Damn <clr>Silvester<clrEnd>! He is incredibly skilful at robot managing and is constantly manoeuvring in the most unimaginable way. He even <clr>manages to duck torpedoes<clrEnd>! Even I, THE GALAXY CHAMPION AMONG MALOQS, could do nothing to him! By the way, he <clr>fires rockets<clrEnd> with pretty damn good grouping. No less then two rockets per shot, bastard! Ooh, if only I met this Human worm somewhere face to face! I would just wrench his arms and legs out!

Maloq's wild excitement made him jump to his feet and get berserk in complete fury. While the guards were trying to calm the rowdy down, you nipped away from the bar to escape your portion of kicking and went to bed. In the morning you freshened up quickly and went to the armoury.

jump.178.desc:
Hardly had you left the playground followed by the wild roar of the elated stands when some too cheeky Peleng appeared as if from nowhere and stood on your way. He grinned arrogantly and said:
- I'm happy to congratulate the great ranger <Ranger> on his outstanding victory in the Intergalactic Tournament. However, I'm not going to waste my breath. Let's stick to business. Do you happen to know that beside the official combat robot competitions there are also backstreet fights? I must say, they stake much more during such fights. The winners earn good money. Actually, this is my offer. Would you like to have a try and take part in these fights? We guarantee, you'll be amply rewarded for your heroism! Let's go to the bar and I'll give you all the details.
jump.179.text: No, thank you, I've already got my share of fighting. And I've had my fill of it too!
